sources.name: Tournament decklists (Magic Online, Melee, Topdeck)
sources.note: Last 42 days, a list counting half as much for every 5 days since it was played. Magic Online: 88 tournaments, 1534 lists from Challenges and other events, 450 from leagues; Melee: 29 tournaments, 3747 lists from Challenges and other events, 0 from leagues; Topdeck: 2 tournaments, 4 lists from Challenges and other events, 0 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. The top 8 of Arena Championship 13, Magic Spotlight: Fracture - SCG CON Hartford - Saturday - 9:00 am, World Championship 32 in Atlanta, USA, 聚光灯系列赛：现实裂界 Magic Spotlight: Fracture count 10 lists each, as players take up those decks. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. Split by their lists, as each held two decks: Dimir Midrange into Dimir Midrange and Dimir Control; Izzet Control into Izzet Control and Izzet Control (Tablet of Discovery); Jeskai Control into Jeskai Control and Jeskai Control (Tablet of Discovery); Sultai Elementals into Sultai Elementals and Sultai Elementals (Consult the Star Charts). This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder. 1 of 5735 lists left out for cards Standard does not allow: Akroma's Vengeance (1), Aura of Silence (1), Barren Moor (1), Caves of Koilos (1), Decree of Justice (1).
